limitations: Synthetic data cannot establish bank effectiveness
Small VAL has coarse FPR resolution
Validation calibration and threshold reuse can overfit; TEST remains untouched during fitting
Account-day forecast, not contemporaneous transaction classification
Cash-out lead-time unavailable without cash-out annotations
metadata.operating_point: VAL only; maximize recall at empirical FPR <= 0.001
